name: filesync
description: Sincronizador de uma pasta em tempo real entre dois PCs, via link/túnel.

scripts.test:unit: for t in reconcile state suppress crypto trash keepalive diskspace identity rename normalize delta daemon; do node test/unit-$t.mjs || exit 1; done && node test/unit.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: node test/e2e.mjs && node test/e2e-offline.mjs && node test/e2e-secure.mjs && node test/e2e-dirs.mjs && node test/e2e-delta.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
